name: contact-form
description: Contact form with a four-layer spam defence and SMTP delivery.

SMTP_HOST.description: Mail server hostname. Leave EMPTY in development — the compose override points the site at the local mail catcher, so nothing can reach a real inbox.

SMTP_USER.description: Set BOTH user and password, or NEITHER. Both empty means an unauthenticated relay; one of each is a misconfiguration and the mailer refuses to send.

MAIL_FROM.description: Envelope sender. Use an address on your own domain or SPF/DKIM will reject it.

MAIL_FROM_NAME.description: Display name on the From header.

FORM_TOKEN_SECRET.description: Signs the form's anti-spam token. Left empty, one is generated and stored automatically.
